addons.name: Custom domain
addons.notes: Domain registration is not included. Requires a module with a public storefront or menu.

addons.name: Assisted onboarding
addons.notes: One-off service quoted per establishment. Never part of the recurring subscription total.

addons.name: Exclusive native apps
addons.notes: Custom contract. Native development is out of scope until phase 12.

addons.name: Exclusive integrations
addons.notes: Custom contract for integrations that QR Connect does not cover.

addons.name: Resources with external costs
addons.notes: Pass-through billing of third-party costs (SMS, maps, cloud OCR) under a published usage policy.
